summary: Ground cabin on the Nez Perce NF, built in 1934 and burned in a forest fire the same year; never replaced. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cabin burned in 1934 and was never replaced; no source describes what remains at the site today.

events.note: Cabin built in 1934 (cabin entry in all four lookout sources)
Burned in a forest fire the same year; never replaced

evidence.supports: 1934 cabin, burned in a forest fire the same year, never replaced

evidence.supports: burned the year it was built, never replaced
evidence.quote: 1934 – Burned in a forest fire the year it was built, and never replaced.

evidence.supports: 17 miles west of Moose Creek RS; cabin built 1934; burned in 1934 forest fire
evidence.quote: Gedney Mountain 17 miles W of Moose cabin 1934 burned in 1934

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1934 cabin and the same-year fire, and none conflicts with the record (kind ground, status gone). No source describes the site today. The Forest Service list places it 17 miles W of Moose Creek RS. A Facebook group post from the Clearwater Trekkers about clearing Gedney Creek trail #708 appeared in search results only; it is undated and was not used.
